email_subject: Application - Growth / Marketing Generalist (Co-builder) at Exhibitly
email_body:
Dear Exhibitly team,

I'm applying for the Growth / Marketing Generalist co-builder role. Your inbound success (250+ events signed without outreach) shows the product sells itself; the missing piece is a voice and a lead engine. That's exactly what I build.

At KXP, I built and optimized mirook.com, implementing JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file, then ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised search health. I also write SEO content that ranks and use AI daily (Claude, ChatGPT) for research, drafting, and audits. I'm comfortable with chaos: I switch between SEO, content, web, and analytics, and I ship.

I want to own the story and the number. I'd love to show you how I'd triple qualified demos in six months.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
